title: Niekie3202s Exploration Pack
description: Exploration Pack is the best modpack to explore the world and play a whole different version and different way of minecraft!
body:
Exploration Pack is the best modpack to explore the world and play a whole different version and different way of minecraft!

In this modpack are the best mods to play minecraft, but still have a different experience than ever before! With mods like Biomes O' Plenty, Towns and Towers, better structures, tectonic and waystones is this the best modpack to explore the world on a different level!

This modpack has a lot of optimization, such as sodium, ModernFix and Chunky for more FPS.

This modpack also includes some mods that should be in vanilla, like appleskin, inventory blur, Just Enough items and Shulker box Tooltip. This modpack has some mods like a world map, litematica and Elytra Slot too, to make it easier and more fun to play minecraft.

I have included some resource packs and shaders to this pack, but feel free to decide what you use and what not! After all, that's what Minecraft is for.
